---
title: "Linz-Sprott System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y\\
\dot{y} &=& z\\
\dot{z} &=& az-y-|x|+1
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.6$ and initial condition $(-1,1,0)$.
